response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.healtheval, 'Missing') as healtheval, COUNT(*) as rec_count FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(s.healtheval, 'Missing')), with_share AS (SELECT rec_count, rec_count::NUMERIC / SUM(rec_count) OVER () as share FROM status_counts), with_avg_share AS (SELECT rec_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () as avg_share FROM with_share), filtered AS (SELECT rec_count, share, avg_share FROM with_avg_share WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT AVG(rec_count) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess FROM filtered
